summary: Iteration 8 (Community Gallery + Before→After framing) PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 iter8 tests pass (test_iteration8.py, 7s). BUG FOUND & FIXED: POST /api/gallery/{kid}/report returned 404 on the first report because MongoDB projection {"_id":0, "reports":1} returns {} when the field is absent, and `if not k:` treats an empty dict as falsy. Changed projection to also include `id` (always present) and the check to `if k is None:` (server.py:788-790). After the fix, all 3-reports-auto-unpublish assertions pass — 3rd report sets is_public=False, kit disappears from GET /api/gallery, and a subsequent report returns 404 as expected. Privacy verified: GET /api/gallery (no auth) returns items with ONLY {id, name, colors, fonts, style_rules, logo, alias, remix_count, published_at} — user_id/email/name are never present, and the raw JSON serialization contains no email string. Publish with alias omitted → gallery_alias='A CreatorForge maker'; custom alias respected (truncated to 40 chars). Non-owner publish → 404 (owner-scoped find). Remix clones colors/fonts/style_rules, sets logo=null and remixed_from=<src_id>, renames to '<name> (remix)', and increments source remix_count by 1. Remix of a non-public or unknown kid → 404. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667, demo login): Studio Creative Tools shows 3 tiles with correct testIDs [tool-palette-generator, tool-community-gallery, tool-templates]; tool-community-gallery navigates to /gallery. Gallery renders gallery-item-<id> tiles with palette + name + 'by <alias>' + remix-<id> + report-<id> buttons. Remix flow: tap remix-<id> → 'Remixed!' celebration modal appears with 'New brand kit' + 'Awesome!' buttons → auto-navigates to /brand-kit/<new_id> which correctly shows '<name> (remix)' header, copied palette + fonts + style rules, and NO logo. Before→After: on a brand kit linked to a project with source_idea, /story/<id> shows the 'before-after-toggle' Switch (testID=before-after-toggle) and 'before-block' (testID=before-block) with 'THE IDEA'/user's idea text/'BECOMES' arrow pill by default; toggling off correctly hides the before-block; when the kit is not linked to a project (or the project has no source_idea/summary), the toggle is correctly absent. story-share-button remains present. Publish flow from brand-kit page: publish-toggle Switch ON → 'Published to the community gallery (anonymous)' toast + backend GET /api/gallery immediately shows the kit with alias='A CreatorForge maker', 0 remixes, and NO email string in the serialized item; toggle OFF → kit removed from gallery. Deprecated packages: NONE detected in this iteration's code paths (all packages current per package.json). React Native issues: carry-over shadow*/pointerEvents warnings only (cosmetic on web).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:788-790 (BEFORE FIX): `find_one({...}, {"_id":0, "reports":1})` returns {} when `reports` is absent, and `if not k:` (empty-dict falsy) misfires as 404. Applied fix: include always-present `id` in projection and switch to `if k is None:`. Same pattern is safe elsewhere because other endpoints either include _id-excluded default projection or use the full doc.

server.py:763-786 remix_brand_kit() correctly nullifies logo, sets remixed_from, and increments source remix_count atomically. No image generation occurs (good — spec-compliant).

rca_of_issue: BUG: POST /api/gallery/{kid}/report returned 404 on first report despite the kit being public. RCA: server.py:788 called db.brand_kits.find_one({'id': kid, 'is_public': True}, {'_id':0, 'reports':1}). When the kit has no 'reports' field yet (fresh publish), MongoDB returns a matching document but the projection contains no included fields → Python receives an empty dict {}. Line 789 then evaluated `if not k:` which is True for {} (empty dict is falsy) → HTTPException(404). This meant reports could NEVER accumulate, making the auto-unpublish feature entirely non-functional in production. FIX: (1) added 'id':1 to projection so the returned dict is always non-empty, and (2) changed condition to `if k is None:` so future absent-field projections cannot regress. Verified via test_iteration8.TestReport.test_three_reports_auto_unpublish which now passes (1st report=200 hidden=False, 2nd=200 hidden=False, 3rd=200 hidden=True, 4th=404, GET /api/gallery no longer contains the kit).
